name: obi-sphere-server
description: The Sphere server: the Obi-to-Obi protocol v0.1's directory, invitations, tokens, policy, relay and audit chain, on Cloudflare Workers with D1.

SPHERE_OPERATOR_TOKEN.description: Paste the token Oby gave you (Settings › Obysphere › Host your own), or any 32+ random characters you keep safe.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional: leave it empty. A Google OAuth Web client ID, so your team can create Obyspheres by signing in with Google instead of with the token ([how](https://github.com/obi-ai-bot/obi-sphere/blob/main/docs/run-your-own.md#optional-let-your-team-create-obyspheres)).

CREATOR_WORKSPACES.description: Optional: leave it empty. The Google Workspace domains whose people may create Obyspheres by signing in, comma-separated, like `acme.com`. Needs `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`.
